en.name: Garlic chive flowers
en.summary: Garlic chive flowers are the thick flowering stems of the garlic chive, topped with a tight bud cluster, stir-fried whole with pork or squid. No published figure covers them, so treat them like chives: about 4–7 days refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, stretched a little because the stems are much sturdier than the leaves.
en.pantry: Flowering stems should not be left at room temperature. Cut stems keep trying to finish flowering, so a bunch left out opens its white flowers within a day or two — and once the flowers open the stems have gone woody and the dish will be stringy. There is no room-temperature figure and none should be assumed; refrigerate the bunch as soon as you get home.
en.fridge: Bag the stems dry and store them in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where about 4–7 days is the working limit. That figure is borrowed from chives, extended because the thick flowering stems are considerably sturdier than the flat leaves; nobody has published a number for the flowering stems themselves. Keep them dry: moisture in the bag is what turns the cut ends slimy. Seal the bag properly too, because cut garlic chives scent everything else in the fridge.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline exists for garlic chive flowers, so we do not give one. They can be chopped, surface-dried and frozen flat in a sealed bag at −18 °C (0 °F), cooked from frozen, and anything at that temperature stays safe indefinitely. But the point of these stems is their snap in a hot wok, and freezing turns them limp. If you have too many, chop and salt them into a relish, or use them up in a batch of dumpling filling and freeze that.
en.thawing: Cook frozen chive flowers from frozen, straight into a hot pan. Thawed stems collapse and weep, and they will steam rather than fry.
spoilage: The white flowers opened out, with the stems gone woody
Slimy or yellowing cut ends where the bunch was tied
Stems gone limp and bendy instead of snapping
A sour or fermented smell rather than a sharp garlicky one
tips: Buy stems with tight closed buds — open flowers mean woody stems.
Bag them dry, and seal the bag so the smell stays in it.
Trim a centimetre off the cut ends before cooking.
Cook them hot and fast; they need barely a minute in the wok.

faq.q: How long do garlic chive flowers last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 4–7 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, bagged dry in the crisper. That figure is borrowed from chives and stretched for the sturdier stems; none is published for the flowering stems.

faq.q: Can you eat the flower buds?
faq.a: Yes, while they are still closed — the tight bud clusters are the best part. Once the white flowers have opened the stems have turned woody and are not worth cooking.

faq.q: Can you freeze garlic chive flowers?
faq.a: No timeline is published, so we do not give one. Chopped and frozen flat at −18 °C (0 °F) they cook from frozen, but freezing costs them the crispness that is the point.

faq.q: Why do they make my fridge smell?
faq.a: Cut garlic chives release sulphur compounds continuously. Seal them in a proper bag or a lidded box and the rest of the fridge is safe.

zh.name: 韭菜花
zh.summary: 韭菜花是韭菜抽出來的粗花莖，頂端帶著一叢緊實的花苞，整根切段炒肉絲或炒魷魚。它沒有公布的保存數據，可以比照韭菜來看：4°C 以下冷藏約 4～7 天，因為花莖比葉子結實得多，可以往上抓一點。
zh.pantry: 抽薹的花莖不應該放室溫。切下來的莖仍然在努力完成開花，所以整把放在外面，一兩天內白花就開了——花一開，莖就老了，炒起來全是纖維。這裡不提供常溫保存天數，也請不要自行推估；買回家請立刻冷藏。
zh.fridge: 請保持乾燥裝袋，放在 4°C 以下的蔬果保鮮室，約 4～7 天是工作上限。這個數字是比照韭菜而來，並因為粗花莖比扁平葉片結實得多而往上調整；沒有人為韭菜花本身公布過數字。重點是保持乾燥：袋裡的水氣正是讓切口變黏的原因。袋子也要確實封好，因為切過的韭菜類會把味道傳給冰箱裡所有東西。
zh.freezer: 韭菜花沒有冷凍保存期限，所以我們不提供數字。它可以切段、把表面水分擦乾後平鋪裝密封袋放 −18°C，使用時不解凍直接下鍋；食品在該溫度下安全上可無限期保存。但這種莖的重點就是下熱鍋那一口脆度，冷凍會讓它變得軟趴趴。真的太多的話，切碎醃成韭菜花醬，或包成一批水餃再冷凍。
zh.thawing: 冷凍韭菜花請不解凍直接下熱鍋。解凍後的莖會塌軟出水，下鍋只會一直冒水而炒不起來。
spoilage: 白花已經綻開，莖也變得粗硬
綁束處的切口變黏或泛黃
聞起來有酸味或發酵味，而不是嗆辣的蒜韭香
tips: 挑花苞緊閉沒開的；花開了就代表莖老了。
保持乾燥裝袋，並把袋口封好，味道才不會跑出來。
下鍋前把切口再切掉約一公分。
大火快炒，在鍋裡其實只需要一分鐘不到。

faq.q: 韭菜花放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏、保持乾燥裝袋放蔬果室，約 4～7 天。這個數字是比照韭菜並因莖較結實而往上調整；韭菜花本身沒有公布的數據。

faq.q: 韭菜花的花苞可以吃嗎？
faq.a: 還沒開的時候可以，而且緊實的花苞正是最好吃的部分。白花一旦綻開，莖就已經老掉，不太值得炒了。
沒有公布的期限，所以我們不給數字。切段平鋪冷凍於 −18°C 可以不解凍直接下鍋，但冷凍會犧牲掉它最重要的脆度。

faq.q: 為什麼冰箱都是韭菜味？
faq.a: 切過的韭菜類會持續釋出含硫化合物。請用密封袋或有蓋保鮮盒裝好，冰箱裡其他東西就安全了。
